title: Trying to find something slightly specific....

posts.author: Doktor_von_Zwitter
posts.body: I'm trying to find battlers of clergy. Bonus points if one is kind of rather stern-looking and perfect for a boss fight. It's amazing how difficult this flavor of enemy is to find. But then, I guess many don't usually consider priestly sorts to be enemies.

posts.author: Doktor_von_Zwitter
posts.body: Kind of. I mean, that could definitely work into the flavor.
